question_results.question: The Quran was compiled in book form (Mushaf) during the caliphate of Hazrat _______ (RA).
Why was the standardisation of the Quranic text under Hazrat Uthman (RA) important? [4 marks]
question_results.student_answer: It combine all muslims on one Qirat, also on one standard version of Quran since before that different surhas were present at different places and companions who memorize Quran were martyred in battles.
question_results.correct_answer: Different regions were using different dialect copies leading to disputes. Hazrat Uthman (RA) formed a committee led by Zayd ibn Thabit to produce a standard text in the Qurayshi dialect. Multiple copies were sent to all provinces. Other copies were burned to prevent division. This preserved unity of the Ummah and ensured the Quran's authentic preservation.
